* Analyzing and reporting on sales performance
* Managing product availability and pricing

tables.name: MATDOC
tables.description:
MATDOC is a standard SAP Table which is used to store Material Documents data and is available within S/4 HANA SAP systems depending on the version and release level. Below is the technical details and the list of fields specifically relevant for an SAP S/4 HANA system

Even using an S/4 Hana system you can still view further information about the SAP MATDOC table and the data within it using standard SAP GUI transactions such as SE11, SE80 or SE16. Or you can use the ADT (ABAP development tools within eclipse).

Delivery Class: A - Application table (master and transaction data)
Display/Maintenance via SM30: Display/Maintenance Allowed but with Restrictions
Enhancement category: Can be enhanced (character-type or numeric)
Dictionary Type: Transparent table
Database Table: MATDOC

agent_feedback.analysis:
The EKBE table stores history of changes to purchasing documents. It is used to track changes to the document header, item data, and account assignment data. The table is used to provide a complete audit trail of all changes to purchasing documents. The EKBE table is linked to the purchasing document header table (EKKO) and the purchasing document item table (EKPO) through the fields EBELN, EBELP, and ZEKKN. Common use cases include:
- Tracking changes to purchasing documents
- Auditing changes to purchasing documents
- Identifying who made changes to purchasing documents
- Restoring purchasing documents to a previous state

tables.description:
ACDOCA is a standard SAP Table which is used to store Universal Journal Entry Line Items data and is available within S/4 HANA SAP systems depending on the version and release level. Below is the technical details and the list of fields specifically relevant for an SAP S/4 HANA system

Even using an S/4 Hana system you can still view further information about the SAP ACDOCA table and the data within it using standard SAP GUI transactions such as SE11, SE80 or SE16. Or you can use the ADT (ABAP development tools within eclipse).

Delivery Class: A - Application table (master and transaction data)
Display/Maintenance via SM30: Display/Maintenance Allowed but with Restrictions
Enhancement category: Can be enhanced (character-type or numeric)
Dictionary Type: Transparent table
Database Table: ACDOCA

agent_feedback.analysis: The purpose of the MKPF table is to store header data for material documents in the SAP system. It contains information such as document number, document type, posting date, and other relevant details. This table is commonly used in conjunction with other tables, such as the MSEG table which stores item-level data for material documents, to provide a comprehensive view of material movements within the system.

**Technical description of table T179T:** This table stores the text descriptions for product hierarchies in multiple languages. Relationships with other tables: - T179: Product hierarchies
- T000: Clients
- T002: Language keys

This table defines the descriptions for customer group 5 in different languages.
It is related to tables TVV5, T000, and T002 through foreign key relationships.
Common use cases include retrieving customer group 5 descriptions.

The TVV4T table stores descriptions for customer group 4. It is related to the TVV4 table through the KVGR4 field and to the T000 and T002 tables through the MANDT and SPRAS fields, respectively. Common use cases include retrieving customer group 4 descriptions based on language and client.

agent_feedback.analysis:
The MARA table in SAP is the central table for material master data. It stores general information about materials, such as their description, unit of measure, weight, and dimensions. It also stores information about the material's availability, such as its stock status and reorder point. The MARA table is used by a variety of SAP modules, including Materials Management (MM), Sales and Distribution (SD), and Plant Maintenance (PM). It is also used by third-party applications that integrate with SAP. Common use cases for the MARA table include: * Creating new materials
* Updating existing materials
* Displaying material information
* Searching for materials
* Generating reports on materials

**Technical Description** TVTW maintains organizational unit distribution channels, providing a structure for assigning channels to clients. It has no direct foreign key relationships to other tables. **Common Use Cases** * Assigning distribution channels to clients for organizational purposes
